rationale: Calculated short-circuit currents for three fault locations (near bus, mid feeder, remote end). Max 3-phase fault current is 9.304 kA at near bus. Min 2-phase fault current is 1.509 kA at remote end. Breaker selected as smallest standard rating (12.5 kA) above required 10.234 kA (9.304 kA × 1.1 safety factor). Relay pickup set to 600 A, between load margin minimum (450 A = 360 A × 1.25) and sensitivity maximum (754.5 A = 1509 A / 2.0).
